remarks: Classic Colonial Split with beautiful water views of Horseshoe Pond, ideally set in the heart of Wilton with the rare convenience of walking to town. Enjoy privacy and charm on a beautifully landscaped, fenced-in backyard, while being just moments from the NRVT, shopping, transportation, and major roadways. Sun-filled and thoughtfully designed, the main level offers an easy flow for everyday living and entertaining. The spacious eat-in kitchen features gorgeous new quartz countertops and backsplash and opens to the backyard deck and flagstone patio, creating seamless indoor-outdoor living. Additional highlights include a formal dining room with chair rail and bay window, a living room with a wood-burning fireplace, and a private lower-level retreat with full bath and separate entrance. With 4 bedrooms, 3 full baths, TOWN WATER, and the convenience of Wilton's town electric grid, this much-loved and well-maintained home is ready for its next owner to enjoy as much as the current owners have for the past 31 years.
